text:
**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Count duplicate outcomes as confirmed defects**

When the comparison record marks a finding as `duplicate`, excluding that outcome removes a valid defect that both reviewers found instead of including it once in the denominator and numerator. Fresh evidence beyond the earlier denominator fix is the existing benchmark contract at `docs/specs/developments/20260910143722_24-review-quality-benchmark-suite/1_24-review-quality-benchmark-suite_specs.md:250-251`, which defines `duplicate` as both reviewers finding the same underlying issue; `src/cli/summarize-review-comparisons.ts:118-120` also maps an `already_found` miss verdict to this outcome. Treat `duplicate` as a confirmed defect and deduplicate it by underlying identity rather than excluding it.

rationale: Author fixed it: Fixed in 9bc88e8. Ronda v0.2.0 posted no matching finding on this head. Spec PR counted in scope: Ronda reviews spec PRs and reports no findings. Verdict drafted by the assistant and accepted by LH without per-record review (delegated 2026-09-30).
